map.最常见是时间不同步：TOTP 基于 Unix 时间按 30 秒步长计算，客户端与: The most common cause is unsynchronized time: TOTP is computed from Unix time in 30-second steps, so if the client and server clocks differ by more than the tolerance window it fails and you should calibrate NTP first.
